name: GLS Winter Camp 2019
information:
Competition are dedicated for cubers who want to take a part in cubing training program. 
First part of each day will be focused on pro lessons with cubing teachers. After that we will have integration game and dinner. 
After dinner we planed 3 rounds of official event. One event / day (without cut-offs). Without rush and with attention for all cubers. 

We invite people who want to make progress with Fridrich Metod 3x3x3 and pro methods in 2x2, pyraminx, and skewb. 

This competition will be a training and integration camp before GLS League 2019.
